description: Fixed 30-message user script for the HW6 Part 3 SHORT_TERM_N sweep. The persona (Priya) is fictional test data. Facts the probes ask about are stated early (turns 1-5) or updated mid-way (turn 14, turn 19), so a short window has to rely on summaries and episodic memory.
messages: Hi, I'm Priya. I'm relocating to San Jose next year for a job at a battery startup.
My maximum budget for rent is $2,600 per month, utilities not included.
I have a dog named Biscuit. He is a 30-pound beagle, so the place has to be pet friendly.
I want to move in on January 15, 2027.
I need two bedrooms because my partner works from home and needs an office.
Which San Jose neighborhoods are usually good for young professionals?
How far is Willow Glen from downtown San Jose?
Is street parking usually hard to find in Willow Glen?
I'd like in-unit laundry if possible. How common is that in older buildings?
What is a typical security deposit for a two-bedroom in San Jose?
Are there limits on how much a landlord can raise rent each year in California?
What documents do landlords usually ask for with a rental application?
Do most complexes charge a monthly pet rent for dogs?
Update: I got a raise, so my maximum rent budget is now $2,900 per month.
Would that budget work for a two-bedroom near Japantown?
How long are typical lease terms in the Bay Area?
Is it better to rent from a big management company or an individual landlord?
What should I check during an apartment viewing?
One more thing: I'm allergic to carpet dust, so I need hardwood or vinyl floors.
Are hardwood floors common in Willow Glen rentals?
How early should I start looking if I want to move in mid-January?
Can a landlord refuse a dog because of its breed?
What does a renter's insurance policy usually cost per month?
Should I ask for a parking spot to be written into the lease?
How do I know if a listing is a scam?
Is a 12-month lease usually cheaper per month than a 6-month lease?
What questions should I ask about noise between units?
Are utilities like water and trash usually included in San Jose rents?
How long does a landlord have to return a security deposit in California?
Thanks, that is all for today. Please remember my requirements for next time.
